sources.snippet: Seedance 2.0 What Is Seedance 2.0? Seedance 2.0 is a multimodal AI video generation model built by ByteDance. It creates 1080p video with native audio from text, images, and reference files in a single pass. Ranked among the top AI video models globally, it powers text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-guided generation, video editing, and beat-sync workflows, all in one browser workspace.
